title: Strategic illumination brief for Q2 roadmap commitments
creator: Anika Sharma
description:
Purpose: Prepare a concise, evidence-backed brief for the Q2 executive readout that clarifies which roadmap commitments require cross-org investment (runtime optimizations, Dedicated capacity ops, Console rollout features) and the operational trade-offs. This brief is intended to replace a long-form QBR slide dump with a three-decision packet: (1) resource reallocation among runtime vs console, (2) go/no-go on a Dedicated autoscaling pilot, (3) one contingency ask for capacity headroom.

Scope: Synthesized signals from product telemetry, recent perf benchmarks, infra capacity forecasts, and customer advisory board asks. Not a full program plan—decision-focused and tied to measurable OKR targets.

Audience: Executive leadership, Eng leads (runtime/team infra), GTM leads for Dedicated, Finance repr.

Deliverables: 1) 6-slide exec packet + 1-page decision memo, 2) annotated cost-econ appendix (token-level assumptions), 3) a short runbook for post-decision follow-ups (owners, milestones, metrics).
acceptance_criteria: 6-slide exec packet uploaded to Drive and linked in this ticket
Decision memo with explicit asks and success metrics for each ask
Cross-functional alignment meeting completed with recorded notes and owners assigned
Finance sign-off on the cost assumptions in appendix
decisions_requested: Prioritize a $450k Q2 runtime perf experiment (kernel selection + batching) with target: 20% p50 token cost reduction by EOW Q2
Approve Dedicated autoscaling pilot (3-week pilot, 2 customer cohorts) and commit SRE rotation hours
Allocate contingency headroom (10% GPU burst pool) for the first 6 weeks after public launch
metrics_and_okrs: OKR: Reduce effective per-token serving cost. Target: -18% cost/unit by 2025-06-30
OKR: Customer latency SLO: maintain p95 <= 420ms for 90% of serving traffic
Initiative KPI: Dedicated pilot conversion rate >= 15% for trial cohort
Operational KPI: Incidents due to autoscaling regressions = 0 (during pilot)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Kernel-level changes cause regression for long-context models. Mitigation: Two-stage canary with fallback to current kernels and nightly regression suite (ENG to own)
Risk: Finance pushback on upfront commit. Mitigation: Present tiered ask (small pilot then scale) and include detailed token-cost sensitivity table
Risk: Customer confusion during Dedicated pilot. Mitigation: Design pilot onboarding checklist and single-threaded contact (Solutions Eng)
stakeholders: Engineering: Priya Nand (runtime lead), Diego Morales (SRE)
